# 0014 — Account ids are stable slugs, not uuids

**Status:** accepted
**Date:** 2026-08-20

## Context

Source code has to be able to name one specific pot: the transaction form pre-selects the
*unknown* account. An id generated by the database cannot be written into the source, and demo
mode and live mode would then hold different ids for the same pot. No test would catch that,
because the tests only ever see the demo data.

## Decision

Account ids follow the pattern `<whose>-<what>` and the column is text rather than a uuid. A slug
is never renamed. What a pot is called lives in `name` and stays free to change.

## Consequences

Uuids solve a problem a hand-maintained table of seven rows does not have.

This is the opposite rule to the one for categories, and it holds only here. See
[0011](0011-category-ids-are-chosen-never-derived-from-the-name.md).
